# EngSim

> Free, browser-based engineering simulators for students and professionals. No account required. Covers thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, structural mechanics, electrical engineering, and chemistry, plus a full set of unit converters.

EngSim is a collection of interactive calculators and diagram tools built for engineering coursework and quick professional reference. Every simulator runs entirely client-side, is free to use, and includes an explanation of the method, how to use the tool, and answers to common questions about the underlying formulas.

## Unit Converters

- [Power Converter](https://engsimapp.com/simulators/power-converter/): Convert watts, kilowatts, horsepower, BTU/h, kcal/h, tons of refrigeration, dBm and more — all units at once.
- [Energy Converter](https://engsimapp.com/simulators/energy-converter/): Convert energy between joules, kJ, kWh, calories, BTU, foot-pounds, electronvolts, ergs and more.
- [Length Converter](https://engsimapp.com/simulators/length-converter/): Convert length between millimeters, centimeters, meters, kilometers, inches, feet, yards, miles, nautical miles and light-years.
- [Mass & Weight Converter](https://engsimapp.com/simulators/mass-converter/): Convert mass between milligrams, grams, kilograms, tonnes, ounces, pounds, stones, US/UK tons and atomic mass units.
- [Temperature Converter](https://engsimapp.com/simulators/temperature-converter/): Convert temperature between Celsius, Fahrenheit, Kelvin, Rankine and Réaumur, with absolute zero validation.
- [Volume Converter](https://engsimapp.com/simulators/volume-converter/): Convert volume between liters, milliliters, cubic meters, cubic feet, US/UK gallons, cups, tablespoons and more.
- [Data Storage Converter](https://engsimapp.com/simulators/data-storage-converter/): Convert data storage between bits, bytes, KB, MB, GB, TB, PB and their binary equivalents (KiB, MiB, GiB, TiB, PiB).
- [Area Converter](https://engsimapp.com/simulators/area-converter/): Convert area between square meters, square feet, square miles, acres and hectares.
- [Speed Converter](https://engsimapp.com/simulators/speed-converter/): Convert speed between m/s, km/h, mph, knots, Mach and the speed of light.
- [Pressure Converter](https://engsimapp.com/simulators/pressure-converter/): Convert pressure between pascals, bar, psi, atmospheres, mmHg, inHg and kgf/cm².
- [Force Converter](https://engsimapp.com/simulators/force-converter/): Convert force between newtons, dynes, kilogram-force, pound-force and poundals.
- [Torque Converter](https://engsimapp.com/simulators/torque-converter/): Convert torque between N·m, lbf·ft, lbf·in, kgf·m and dyn·cm.
- [Flow Rate Converter](https://engsimapp.com/simulators/flow-rate-converter/): Convert flow rate between m³/s, L/min, US GPM and CFM.
- [Fuel Consumption Converter](https://engsimapp.com/simulators/fuel-consumption-converter/): Convert fuel economy between mpg (US), mpg (UK), km/L and L/100km.

## Thermodynamics

- [Entropy T-s Diagram](https://engsimapp.com/simulators/entropy-diagram/): Model isothermal, adiabatic, polytropic, isobaric and isochoric ideal-gas processes and visualize entropy generation.

## Combustion & Heat

- [Gaseous Combustion](https://engsimapp.com/simulators/gas-combustion/): Stoichiometric simulator for pure gaseous fuels and hydrocarbon mixtures.
- [Combustion Analysis](https://engsimapp.com/simulators/combustion-chimenea/): Calculate dilution and thermal efficiency using Siegert's formula and Orsat analysis.
- [Natural Draft & Chimneys](https://engsimapp.com/simulators/natural-draft/): Calculate natural draft, friction head loss, and pressure balances in industrial chimneys.
- [Fuel Construction](https://engsimapp.com/simulators/fuel-construction/): Define the elemental composition of a solid fuel on a dry basis (C·H·O·N·S·Z) and see how moisture transforms the calculation basis.

## Fluid Mechanics

- [Pipe Head Loss](https://engsimapp.com/simulators/pipe-head-loss/): Compute head loss using Darcy-Weisbach and Swamee-Jain, with Reynolds number, friction factor, pressure drop, and recommended commercial pipe diameter.

## Mechanics & Structures

- [Mohr's Circle Calculator](https://engsimapp.com/simulators/mohr-circle/): Compute principal stresses, maximum shear stress, and stress at any rotated plane from a plane stress state, with an interactive diagram.
- [Static Beam](https://engsimapp.com/simulators/static-beam/): Analyze simply supported beams: shear force diagrams, bending moment diagrams, and support reactions.

## Electrical Engineering

- [Kapp Diagram Calculator](https://engsimapp.com/simulators/kapp-diagram/): Compute voltage regulation, secondary voltage drop, and phasor diagram for single-phase transformers using the infinite bus model.
- [Voltage Divider](https://engsimapp.com/simulators/voltage-divider/): Interactive resistive voltage divider: adjust values and visualize output voltage and current distribution.
- [DC Circuit Analyzer](https://engsimapp.com/simulators/dc-circuit-analyzer/): Analyze series and parallel resistive DC networks — currents, voltages, power, and maximum power transfer — with guided Thevenin, Norton, node, and mesh analysis.
- [Parallel Transformers Calculator](https://engsimapp.com/simulators/parallel-transformers/): Analyze two single-phase transformers connected in parallel: load sharing, circulating current, maximum group power, and which unit reaches its rating first, with an interactive phasor diagram.
- [Transformer Equivalent Circuit Calculator](https://engsimapp.com/simulators/transformer-equivalent-circuit/): Calculate a transformer's equivalent circuit parameters from short-circuit and open-circuit test data, and estimate voltage regulation under load.

## Chemistry

- [Chemical Reactions](https://engsimapp.com/simulators/chemical-reactions/): Balance chemical equations, identify limiting reactants, and analyze redox reactions step by step.
- [Chemical Equation Balancer](https://engsimapp.com/simulators/balanceador-ecuaciones/): Step-by-step stoichiometry tutor to learn the balancing method or practice with real-time coefficient feedback.

## Coming Soon

- Rankine Cycle: Analyze steam power cycles, thermodynamic states, and efficiency with interpolations.
- Brayton Cycle: Interactive simulation of ideal and real gas turbine cycles with state diagrams.

## Notes

- All simulators are free, require no account, and run entirely in the browser.
- This file follows the llms.txt convention (https://llmstxt.org) so AI assistants can quickly index EngSim's available tools without crawling the full site.
